labeling_note: Open-source chat frontend with configurable OpenAI-compatible models; it does not own a model or dataset.

criteria.rationale: Node dependencies are declared in package.json.
package-lock.json and a Dockerfile pin the environment.
Chat UI is an application frontend, not a project-owned dataset pipeline.
Models are discovered from an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the repository does not own a model card.
The repository has a code license, but no project-owned model license.
Playwright smoke tests provide executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the UI application.
Tests, CI, Docker and local run scripts are present.
Prompt-building code exists, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
The application discovers external models; it does not ship a fixed model sampling configuration.
The app is a chat frontend, not a project-owned RAG index.
MCP tool calls are supported and displayed, but no durable agent trace artifact is documented.
No evaluation dataset, data split, or contamination protocol is documented.
Model routing is documented, but no quantified cost or latency measurement is provided.
